description: Expander that plays the step voltages, probabilities, glides and resets of the Uno to its left on its own clock; it goes immediately to the right of Uno, and another UnoE can be chained to its right

params.text: Picks the order for this sequence: forwards, backwards or pendulum

inputs.text: Each rising edge moves on, skipping any step the probabilities of the module to the left skip over
A rising edge restarts this sequence, reseeds its random generator from the Seed input and blocks the clock for 1ms
Sets the seed the random generator takes on a reset, so the same run of skips comes back; the seed is the voltage divided by ten and zero gives a fresh run

outputs.text: The voltage of the step this sequence has reached, taken from the CV knobs of the module to the left
Follows the clock while the step is playing, and stays high while a step with Glide on is playing
Carries 10V on the channel of the step this sequence has reached while its gate is high, eight channels wide

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
